hooks.name: pre-tool-shell-guard
hooks.description: Blocks destructive shell commands and writes to protected system paths.

hooks.name: edit-circuit-breaker
hooks.description: Halts execution when a single file is modified more than 5 times within 10 minutes.

hooks.name: post-edit-policy-check
hooks.description: Scans modified files for prohibited continuous polling, styling policy drift, debug logs, and KISS complexity/error-handling heuristics.

hooks.name: audit-log-writer
hooks.description: Appends structured JSON and Markdown audit entries to .agents/audit_log.json.

hooks.name: skill-security-scanner
hooks.description: Scans agent skills for prompt injection, credential harvesting, and C2 exfiltration patterns.
